title: 换行符翻译：newline=None / '' / '\n'
expected_output:
文件原始字节 = 610d0a620a630d64

newline=None (默认, 通用换行) -> 'a\nb\nc\nd'
newline=''  (不转换)        -> 'a\r\nb\nc\rd'
newline='\n' (仅按 \n 断行) -> 'a\r\nb\nc\rd'

默认模式迭代行数 = 4
newline='' 迭代行数 = 4

要点: 读 csv 必须 newline='' ，否则字段内的换行会被先行处理掉
code:
from pathlib import Path

p = Path("nl.txt")
p.write_bytes(b"a\r\nb\nc\rd")
print("文件原始字节 =", p.read_bytes().hex())
print()

with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    print("newline=None (默认, 通用换行) ->", repr(f.read()))

with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    print("newline=''  (不转换)        ->", repr(f.read()))

with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
    print("newline='\\n' (仅按 \\n 断行) ->", repr(f.read()))
print()

with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    print("默认模式迭代行数 =", len(f.readlines()))
with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    print("newline='' 迭代行数 =", len(f.readlines()))
print()
print("要点: 读 csv 必须 newline='' ，否则字段内的换行会被先行处理掉")
